description: This file defines a PHP class 'Curl' within the namespace 'Opencart\System\Library\Cart'. The class encapsulates functionality to perform HTTP requests using cURL, allowing setting options, and sending data to a specified URL, with handling for response decoding and status checking.

classes.name: Curl
classes.description: A class providing simplified cURL HTTP request capabilities, including setting options and sending POST requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Curl object with the target URL.

methods.name: setOption
methods.description: Sets or updates a cURL option for the request.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Executes the cURL request with current options and returns the response decoded as an array if the HTTP status is 200.
